description: Search the One-Click Apps catalog for a dedicated server (name, description, category, paged). Use the type with get_dedicated_app_catalog_entry before installing. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

search.description: Free text search over name, description and tags.

serviceId.description: ID of the Dedicated server: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_dedicated_servers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: list_dedicated_app_catalog
title: Search Dedicated Server App Catalog
